servicesLabel: From the first sketch to the next release
servicesIntro:
A new product, a better existing one,

or one specific problem to solve.
s1p: User flows, prototypes and interface design. A clear scope before development begins.
s2p: Websites, SaaS, customer portals and CRM systems. From the interface to APIs and integrations.
s3p: iOS and Android apps with React Native + Expo. PWA and Telegram Mini Apps with React/Vue, built around your users and their needs.
s4p: New features, migrations, performance work and third-party integrations in existing products.
s5p: Testing, deployment, analytics and a clear handover. Support and further releases as needed.
s6p: An indexable website, clear service pages and useful case studies. A foundation for search and AI discovery.
processLabel: A clear route from here to launch
processIntro:
You see the progress and take part

in the decisions that matter.
p1p: The problem, the people using the product and the result you're after.
p2p: Define the scope, design the key screens and agree on delivery stages.
p3p: Develop in stages, show working progress and refine it together.
p4p: Test, release and hand over. Plan further improvements when you need them.
aboutLead: I'm Stanislav. I bring six years of development experience to products that people use to learn, work and run their businesses.
aboutBody: You work directly with me. I take on the work myself and bring in specialists when the project needs them — with a clear scope and one point of contact.
q1: Can you improve an existing product?
a1: Yes. I take on individual features, integrations, bug fixes and larger modernisation projects. We start with your current setup and priorities.
q2: Do I need to have a design ready?
a2: No. We can begin with an idea and work through the structure, user flows and design. If you already have designs, I can build from them.
q3: How much will my project cost?
a3: We discuss the budget in a meeting, once I understand the scope, priorities and timing. Send me a short description to start the conversation.
q4: Will I work with you or a team?
a4: You'll work directly with me. If the project needs additional skills or capacity, we discuss the team and responsibilities in advance.
